descriptions.description: Lectotype (de Vos in J. S. African Bot. 45: 338. 1979): [icon] " Ferraria foliis nervosis, ensiformibus, vaginantibus; petalis fimbriatis " in Burman in Nova Acta Phys. - Med. Acad. Caes. Leop. - Carol. Nat. Cur. 2: 199, t. 3, f. 1. 1761.
" Habitat ad Cap. b. spei. " RCN: 6910.
Note: A superfluous name for F. crispa Burm. (1761), cited explicitly in the protologue, as noted by Moore (in Baileya 19: 110. 1974).
Regularly or recently cultivated agricultural, horticultural and domestic habitats (I level 1)
Heathland, scrub and tundra habitats (F level 1)
Constructed, industrial and other artificial habitats (J level 1)
Coastal dunes and sandy shores (B1 level 2)
